scope: Exploratory loss-weight control against cartesian_overfit/mixed_eight. Weight 3*(1-tau)^2 with unchanged uniform tau/source/target draws and network. Mean weight is one under uniform tau; realized gradient weighting changes. Same Adam, steps, batch, three seeds. Training weighted loss is NOT comparable to baseline training loss; evaluation loss remains unweighted. Compare all saved path statistics and milestones. High endpoint-stage velocity MSE alone does not prove weighting useful or identify its irreducible component. No held-out physical certification, probability calibration or production promotion.
controls: Same initialization, Adam lr0.001, batch8, width24, blocks2, objective, full L25 paths and training RNG as first loop. Train continuously; evaluate only after all milestones saved.
interpretation: Compare physical statistics and train/development losses across all three seeds. Lower training loss alone is not success. Legacy basin definition and two development initial families are not formal certification. Other model kinds are not retrained; this is not a fair-budget cross-model comparison.
